items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Well Louie Bellson replaced me with Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: Well Louie Bellson replaced me with Benny Goodman. He had just been discharged from the army, so when he was discharged, he replaced me and I went back to my studio work and my drum school.
It says during the '40s did extensive studies at Julliard which you've already mentioned. Were you basically a full-time student there?
